# Drone TikTok Sales Package

## Project

- Product: Screen Remote Foldable Drone
- Format: TikTok / 9:16 / 22-28 seconds
- Objective: Make the product feel easy, beginner-friendly, and more practical than phone-controlled entry drones
- Source Truth: Only claims visible in the supplied product images are used

---

## 1. Short-Form Strategy

### Core Hook

This product is not framed as a "professional drone."  
It is framed as a **beginner-friendly ready-to-fly kit with a built-in screen remote**.

### Conversion Angle

People do not need a lecture about drone specs first.  
They need to immediately understand:

1. It uses a screen remote
2. It does not rely on a phone
3. It can take off quickly
4. It feels stable and easy to control
5. The full kit looks complete and giftable

### Emotional Promise

`Less setup friction. Faster first flight.`

---

## 1A. Detailed Selling Point Extraction

### Visible Product Selling Points

#### 1. Built-In Screen Remote

- Strongest differentiator in the supplied images
- Removes the mental barrier of app pairing and phone setup
- Makes the product feel more complete and easier for beginners
- Gives the ad a very clear commerce angle: `you can see what this is in one second`

#### 2. No Mobile Phone Required

- High-conversion consumer message because it sounds simple, practical, and hassle-reducing
- Especially useful for buyers who do not want to deal with downloads, permissions, lag, or weak phone compatibility
- Better framed as `less setup friction` than as a technical specification

#### 3. One-Click Takeoff / Landing

- Great for beginner confidence
- Visually easy to dramatize in short-form video
- Helps move the product from “looks cool” to “feels usable”

#### 4. Optical Flow Hovering

- The word itself sounds technical, but the customer value is not “optical flow”
- The real customer-facing interpretation is:
  `it looks more stable and easier to control`

#### 5. Dual Cameras + Dual Camera Switching

- Gives the ad a built-in “visual payoff” moment
- Helps the product feel more advanced than a basic toy drone
- Creates a reason to cut between viewpoints and keep attention high

#### 6. 90-Degree Angle Adjustment

- Adds extra perceived control without needing to claim professional camera quality
- Best used as a feature accent, not the entire pitch

#### 7. Full Kit Presentation

- The bundle looks complete:
  drone + screen remote + 2 batteries + case + spare props + guards + SD card + reader
- This increases perceived value immediately
- Very useful for CTA framing because the final frame can sell “everything included”

#### 8. Beginner-Friendly Controller Layout

- The labeled remote guide adds trust
- Visible controls like:
  `emergency stop`, `one-click takeoff`, `headless mode`, `speed switching`
  all help reduce first-time buyer anxiety

#### 9. Carry Case + Accessories

- Helps position the product as:
  `ready to go`, `giftable`, `organized`, `travel-friendly`
- This matters more in e-commerce than many technical specs

### Deeper Consumer Interpretation

The buyer is not mainly purchasing “a drone.”  
They are purchasing:

- an easier first drone experience
- a simpler control experience
- a more complete starter bundle
- a product that looks less annoying to set up

That is the real emotional sell.

---

## 1B. Usage Scenario Extraction

### Scenario 1 - First-Time Beginner Flight

- Best use in video: strongest
- Why it works: matches one-click controls, no-phone setup, stable hover language
- Emotional message: `I could probably use this without a frustrating learning curve.`

### Scenario 2 - Backyard / Open Ground Casual Flying

- Best use in video: very strong
- Why it works: easy to visualize takeoff, hover, and controller use
- Emotional message: `simple fun without overcomplication`

### Scenario 3 - Gift Purchase

- Best use in video: strong secondary angle
- Why it works: the full kit looks complete and presentable
- Emotional message: `this looks like a full bundle, not a bare gadget`

### Scenario 4 - Travel / Carry Case Convenience

- Best use in video: supporting angle
- Why it works: carry case and compact foldable body suggest portability
- Emotional message: `easy to pack and bring`

### Scenario 5 - Learning / Practice Drone

- Best use in video: strong
- Why it works: headless mode, one-click functions, visible controls all support low-pressure practice
- Emotional message: `good for learning, not intimidating`

### Scenario 6 - Casual Photo / Video Exploration

- Best use in video: supporting angle only
- Why it works: dual camera switching gives content variety
- Risk: do not imply professional aerial filmmaking

### Best Scenario Priorities For TikTok

If the goal is conversion, the strongest scenario order is:

1. First-time beginner drone
2. No-phone setup convenience
3. Full kit / giftable bundle
4. Casual backyard flying
5. Camera angle switching as visual payoff

### Chinese Intent Notes

- Line 1: Stop-scroll hook, not feature dump
- Line 2: Immediately isolate the strongest selling point: screen remote
- Line 3: Move from convenience into visible capability
- Line 4: Reinforce low-friction beginner positioning
- Line 5: Close on purchase action with "bundle" and "ready to go"

## 4. Shot Analysis

### Shot 1 - Hook

- Purpose: Stop the scroll in under 2 seconds
- Best selling object: drone body + powered screen remote
- Why it converts: it looks like a real gadget, not a toy listing screenshot
- Risk: do not open with static full product layout, it will feel like a PPT page

### Shot 2 - Feature Reveal

- Purpose: Establish the most differentiated offer
- Best selling object: built-in LCD remote
- Why it converts: "no phone required" is easier to understand than abstract specs
- Risk: avoid clutter; this beat should be about the controller, not accessories

### Shot 3 - Takeoff

- Purpose: prove instant action
- Best selling object: one-click ease + real flight motion
- Why it converts: viewers trust motion more than spec cards
- Risk: if flight looks fake or floaty, trust drops fast

### Shot 4 - Hover

- Purpose: sell beginner confidence
- Best selling object: stable hover
- Why it converts: buyers imagine "I can probably use this"
- Risk: do not oversell as pro stabilization or GPS

### Shot 5 - Camera Switching

- Purpose: move from "easy" to "feature-rich"
- Best selling object: dual camera angle change
- Why it converts: creates visual payoff and keeps pacing alive
- Risk: do not claim resolution or advanced cinema footage

### Shot 6 - Remote Operation

- Purpose: reinforce ease of use in human hands
- Best selling object: visible buttons around the LCD
- Why it converts: tactile controls feel safer and more beginner-friendly
- Risk: avoid inventing functions not visible on the guide

### Shot 7 - CTA Hero Kit

- Purpose: close the sale
- Best selling object: completeness of the bundle
- Why it converts: the kit looks giftable, practical, and "ready now"
- Risk: accessories should look organized, not cluttered

---

## 5. Shot Size Plan

- `ECU` for power-up, buttons, camera module, battery insert
- `CU` for remote operation and premium hardware feel
- `Medium` for drone + controller relationship
- `Wide` for takeoff, hover, and final kit layout

Recommended visual rhythm:

1. Tight
2. Tight
3. Wide motion
4. Medium motion
5. Fast switch
6. Tight human interaction
7. Wide polished CTA

This rhythm prevents the ad from feeling flat.

## 7. Sales Voiceover Direction

### Recommended Voice Profile

- Language: English
- Gender: either neutral male or confident female
- Tone: warm direct-response, not hype-shouting
- Pace: medium-fast
- Delivery style: product demo + TikTok ad hybrid

### Performance Notes

- The hook should sound curious, not aggressive
- "Built-in screen remote" should be slightly emphasized
- "No phone setup" should land as a relief point
- "Tap to shop now" should sound clean and confident, not hard-sell cheesy

### Suggested Read Style

Think:

- less cinematic movie trailer
- more polished Amazon/TikTok product ad
- energetic but still trustworthy

---

## 8. Sales Music Direction

### Recommended Music Type

- Style: upbeat tech-lifestyle electronic
- BPM: 98-112
- Mood: clean, modern, confident
- Energy curve: quick hook, steady momentum, slight lift into CTA

### What the Music Should Do

- Support motion during takeoff and hover
- Leave space for voiceover
- Feel like product-commerce content, not action movie soundtrack

### Avoid

- epic trailer drums
- childish toy music
- aggressive EDM drops
- emotional piano

### Search Prompt for Background Music

```text
upbeat modern tech product ad background music, clean electronic groove, light punchy beat, commercial lifestyle energy, suitable for short TikTok product ad, no vocals
```

---

## 10. Safe Claims Checklist

Only use these claims in ad copy:

- Built-in screen remote
- No mobile phone required
- Dual cameras
- Dual camera switching
- 90-degree angle adjustment
- One-click takeoff
- One-click landing
- Headless mode
- Optical flow hovering
- 3.7V high-capacity battery
- Full kit with visible accessories

Do not claim:

- GPS
- exact flight range
- exact flight time
- 4K / HD resolution unless separately verified
- strong wind resistance
- professional aerial cinema quality
- verified obstacle avoidance performance

---

## 11. Recommended Next Generation Order

If producing with real video generation, generate in this order:

1. Hover
2. Dual Camera Switch
3. Remote Operation
4. CTA Hero Kit
5. Hook refinement
6. Takeoff alternate

Reason:

- `Hover` and `Dual Camera Switch` are the two best truth tests for whether the ad feels real
- once those work, the rest of the piece becomes easier to trust and finish

## 12. 30-Second TikTok Minimal Execution Version

### Positioning

This is the compressed high-conversion execution version for TikTok.  
It strips away explanation and keeps only:

- strongest hook
- strongest convenience claim
- strongest motion proof
- strongest bundle close

### 30-Second Script

#### English Voiceover

Want a drone that feels easier right out of the box?  
This one has a built-in screen remote, so you can skip the phone setup.  
Take off fast, hold a steady hover, and switch camera angles right from the controller.  
With one-click controls and a full ready-to-fly kit, it feels beginner-friendly from the start.  
Tap to shop now.

#### Super Short Caption Hook Version

```text
No phone setup.
Built-in screen remote.
One-click takeoff.
Stable hover.
Dual camera switch.
Ready-to-fly kit.
Tap to shop now.
```

### 30-Second Storyboard

| Shot | Time | Goal | Visual | Subtitle |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| 1 | 0.0 - 2.5s | Hook | Close-up of drone + remote screen waking up | `No phone setup.` |
| 2 | 2.5 - 6.0s | Core differentiator | Drone and controller together, screen remote emphasized | `Built-in screen remote` |
| 3 | 6.0 - 10.0s | Action proof | Drone takeoff | `One-click takeoff` |
| 4 | 10.0 - 14.0s | Stability proof | Stable hover outdoors | `Stable hover` |
| 5 | 14.0 - 18.0s | Feature payoff | Dual camera switch visual | `Dual camera switch` |
| 6 | 18.0 - 22.0s | Ease-of-use proof | Close-up controller operation | `Beginner-friendly controls` |
| 7 | 22.0 - 30.0s | Conversion close | Full kit hero layout + batteries + case + accessories | `Ready-to-fly kit` / `Tap to shop now` |

### 30-Second Shot Direction

- Hook must land in under 1 second visually
- Use very short subtitle bursts, not full sentence paragraphs
- Prioritize motion and hardware clarity over cinematic beauty
- The final kit shot should feel like a value reveal

### 30-Second Music Direction

- Start immediately with beat, no soft intro
- Keep energy steady through hover and camera switch
- Add a small lift in the last 5 seconds for CTA

### 30-Second Editing Rules

- No long dissolves
- No slow intro
- No informational overload in the first 5 seconds
- No more than 2 subtitle lines on screen at once
- Every 2-4 seconds must reveal a new benefit

### Best Hook Options For A/B Testing

#### Hook A

`No phone setup. Just fly.`

#### Hook B

`This drone comes with its own screen remote.`

#### Hook C

`If you want a beginner drone that feels easier to use, start here.`

### Recommended Best Hook

Use **Hook A** for TikTok first because it is:

- shortest
- clearest
- easiest to understand instantly
- built around convenience, which is the strongest conversion driver in your product images
